engagement_cards.title: Verify Intel Item
engagement_cards.description: Fact-check an unconfirmed note so you don't pitch on false assumptions.

engagement_cards.title: Investigate Component
engagement_cards.description: Ask 1 stakeholder either for their most important requirement or about one MLOps component. Can be played again on the same stakeholder.
engagement_cards.response_snippet: Asked a targeted question about their requirements.

engagement_cards.title: Team Sync-Up
engagement_cards.description: Call a team sync-up across top affected MLOps components. (1x per phase)
engagement_cards.response_snippet: Synced up with all team members to align perspectives.

engagement_cards.title: Patience-Reset
engagement_cards.description: Take dedicated time with 1 impatient stakeholder and fully reset their patience.
engagement_cards.response_snippet: Gave the stakeholder room to breathe.

engagement_cards.title: Pep-Talk
engagement_cards.description: Hold a short stand-up to lift the room's mood. (1x per phase)
engagement_cards.response_snippet: Lifted the room's mood with a quick stand-up.
